<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #578a34; overflow: hidden; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  canvas { display: block; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const GRID = 17;
  const BAR = 1.2; // score bar height in cells
  const START_MS = 130;
  const MIN_MS = 65;
  const COLORS = {
    bar: "#4a752c",
    boardA: "#aad751",
    boardB: "#a2d149",
    snake: "#4674e9",
    snakeHead: "#4674e9",
    apple: "#e7471d",
    stem: "#578a34"
  };
  const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  let cell = 20, boardW = 0, boardH = 0, dpr = 1;
  function resize() {
    dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const availW = window.innerWidth * 0.98;
    const availH = window.innerHeight * 0.98;
    cell = Math.min(availW / GRID, availH / (GRID + BAR));
    boardW = cell * GRID;
    boardH = cell * (GRID + BAR);
    canvas.width = Math.round(boardW * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(boardH * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = boardW + "px";
    canvas.style.height = boardH + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    draw();
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

  let snake, dir, nextDir, food, score, alive, started, stepMs, timer = null;
  function reset() {
    const mid = Math.floor(GRID / 2);
    snake = [{ x: 4, y: mid }, { x: 3, y: mid }, { x: 2, y: mid }];
    dir = { x: 1, y: 0 };
    nextDir = dir;
    score = 0;
    alive = true;
    started = false;
    stepMs = START_MS;
    placeFood();
    draw();
  }

  function placeFood() {
    const taken = new Set(snake.map(s => s.x + "," + s.y));
    let spot;
    do {
      spot = { x: Math.floor(Math.random() * GRID), y: Math.floor(Math.random() * GRID) };
    } while (taken.has(spot.x + "," + spot.y));
    food = spot;
  }

  function start() {
    if (started || !alive) return;
    started = true;
    schedule();
  }

  function schedule() {
    timer = setTimeout(() => { step(); if (alive) schedule(); }, stepMs);
  }

  function step() {
    dir = nextDir;
    const head = { x: snake[0].x + dir.x, y: snake[0].y + dir.y };
    const hitWall = head.x < 0 || head.y < 0 || head.x >= GRID || head.y >= GRID;
    const hitSelf = snake.some(s => s.x === head.x && s.y === head.y);
    if (hitWall || hitSelf) return die();
    snake.unshift(head);
    if (head.x === food.x && head.y === food.y) {
      score += 10;
      stepMs = Math.max(MIN_MS, stepMs - 2);
      placeFood();
    } else {
      snake.pop();
    }
    draw();
  }

  function die() {
    alive = false;
    clearTimeout(timer);
    draw();
    const apples = score / 10;
    window.parent.postMessage({
      type: "nova:score",
      score: score,
      outcome: "loss",
      message: apples === 0 ? "not a single apple. rough." : apples + " apple" + (apples === 1 ? "" : "s") + " deep before it all went wrong"
    }, "*");
  }

  function turn(x, y) {
    if (x === -dir.x && y === -dir.y) return;
    nextDir = { x, y };
    start();
  }

  const KEYS = {
    ArrowUp: [0, -1], ArrowDown: [0, 1], ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0],
    w: [0, -1], s: [0, 1], a: [-1, 0], d: [1, 0],
    W: [0, -1], S: [0, 1], A: [-1, 0], D: [1, 0]
  };
  window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    const k = KEYS[e.key];
    if (!k) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    turn(k[0], k[1]);
  });

  let touchStart = null;
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    touchStart = { x: e.touches[0].clientX, y: e.touches[0].clientY };
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!touchStart) return;
    const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - touchStart.x;
    const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - touchStart.y;
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 24 && Math.abs(dy) < 24) return;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) turn(Math.sign(dx), 0);
    else turn(0, Math.sign(dy));
    touchStart = null;
  }, { passive: false });

  const px = n => n * cell;
  const by = n => (n + BAR) * cell; // board y offset below score bar

  function drawApple(gx, gy) {
    const cx = px(gx) + cell / 2, cy = by(gy) + cell / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.apple;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy + cell * 0.03, cell * 0.36, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.stem;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, cell * 0.08);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - cell * 0.28);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + cell * 0.12, cy - cell * 0.42, cx + cell * 0.18, cy - cell * 0.44);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function draw() {
    // score bar
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bar;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, boardW, cell * BAR);
    drawAppleIcon(cell * 0.62, cell * BAR / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = `700 ${Math.round(cell * 0.6)}px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(String(score / 10), cell * 1.15, cell * BAR / 2 + 1);

    // checkerboard
    for (let y = 0; y < GRID; y++) for (let x = 0; x < GRID; x++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = (x + y) % 2 === 0 ? COLORS.boardA : COLORS.boardB;
      ctx.fillRect(px(x), by(y), cell + 0.5, cell + 0.5);
    }

    drawApple(food.x, food.y);

    // snake body: continuous rounded strip
    const half = cell * 0.42;
    for (let i = snake.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const a = snake[i], b = snake[i - 1];
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.snake;
      const x1 = Math.min(a.x, b.x), y1 = Math.min(a.y, b.y);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(
        px(x1) + cell / 2 - half,
        by(y1) + cell / 2 - half,
        (Math.abs(a.x - b.x) * cell) + half * 2,
        (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) * cell) + half * 2,
        cell * 0.28
      );
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // head
    const h = snake[0];
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.snakeHead;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(px(h.x) + cell / 2 - half, by(h.y) + cell / 2 - half, half * 2, half * 2, cell * 0.3);
    ctx.fill();
    // eyes offset toward travel direction
    const cx = px(h.x) + cell / 2, cy = by(h.y) + cell / 2;
    const fx = dir.x * cell * 0.14, fy = dir.y * cell * 0.14;
    const sx = dir.x === 0 ? cell * 0.17 : 0, sy = dir.y === 0 ? cell * 0.17 : 0;
    for (const sgn of [-1, 1]) {
      const ex = cx + fx + sgn * sx, ey = cy + fy + sgn * sy;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, cell * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#111";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex + dir.x * cell * 0.05, ey + dir.y * cell * 0.05, cell * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }

    if (!started && alive) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, by(GRID * 0.38), boardW, cell * 3.4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.font = `700 ${Math.round(cell * 1.15)}px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillText("SNAKE", boardW / 2, by(GRID * 0.38) + cell * 1.3);
      ctx.font = `400 ${Math.round(cell * 0.55)}px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillText("arrows / wasd / swipe to move", boardW / 2, by(GRID * 0.38) + cell * 2.4);
    }
  }

  function drawAppleIcon(cx, cy) {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.apple;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy + cell * 0.02, cell * 0.26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, cell * 0.05);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - cell * 0.2);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + cell * 0.08, cy - cell * 0.32, cx + cell * 0.13, cy - cell * 0.33);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  reset();
  resize();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
